title: Laboratory LOINC terms, 1,000 per page, property=*
exercises: $expand CLASSTYPE=1 with property=* and count=1000, first page and a deep page
why: Slow-ish: 1,000 rows x every property; row building dominates, not membership.
stresses: 1,000 rows x ~15-25 properties; response in the megabytes

expectedDifferences.reason: tx.fhir.org ignores the $expand property parameter and ValueSet.compose.property: no requested properties are returned (probed on /r4 and /r5, valueCode and valueString, 2026-11-01); it only adds a status property to non-active LOINC codes.
